_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil has produced zero directional breakouts in 50 windows, so HOLD with conviction is the skilled call — a directional bet here requires seeing the breaker and neither brain has confirmed one.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst explicitly grades HOLD with low confidence citing regime noise, while the narrative implies a bullish accumulation setup that would lean toward an eventual UP break; the split is on interpretation of the same sentiment/stablecoin data.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive with funding below 0.01% and BTC holds $62K+, validating institutional re-entry and a shift toward Hope
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows remain at zero with funding rising above 0.015% and BTC breaks below $60K, confirming distribution into Anxiety
